comment: Single source of truth for Phase 5b asset bundles (perf/lcp). The build script (tools/build_asset_bundles.mjs), the web asset() helper (web/src/lib/assets.js) and the API asset() helper (app/web/template_support.py) all read this file: `files` is the concatenation order, `hrefs` are the exact original <link> hrefs used when no manifest exists (flag-off content, and the flag-on fallback when a bundle was not built). Bundle files themselves live in this same directory (static/css/) so relative url() references in the sources (notably fonts.css -> ../fonts/) keep resolving. Do NOT name the manifest static/manifest.json: that URL is the PWA manifest. The asset manifest is static/asset-manifest.json.
